newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil climbs $3.50 in catch-up with Brent.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil climbs $3.50 in catch-up with Brent.

text.p: NWE gas oil gained $3.50 a tonne on Tuesday morning as IPE futures caught up with gains made on Brent late on Monday.
Dealers said premiums for physical oil were unchanged with Rotterdam barges holding at 50 cents above the July IPE which was trading at $175.75 a tonne at 1123 GMT.
"German demand is very subdued. People are on holiday and we have been struggling to find bids," said a broker.
EN590 grade diesel talked $4.50 over the IPE for cargoes which failed to attract buyers despite good demand for forward periods.
Swaps traded at $9 a tonne above the IPE for the fourth quarter compared to recent trade at $8.25 over.

Dealers said the buyer was a trader covering back short positions and did not reflect better end user demand. Swaps talked $5 over the IPE for this month but rise steadily to over $10 in the first quarter next year.
Russian cargoes were thinly discussed with talk around 50 cents over the IPE despite some tightness of prompt loadings.
